title: Engineering Professional Pathways Camp 7/14-7/16
description: Design, build, and innovate at this hands-on engineering camp for grades 6–12. Explore robotics and electronics while solving real problems using creativity, math, and science. Test your own creations and learn how engineers bring ideas to life.

title: Thunder Over Michigan Air Show
description: Look what’s happening right next to campus! The Thunder Over Michigan Air Show hits Willow Run Airport July 17-19. Catch the massive RAF Red Arrows, jet demos, and incredible stunt flying. Just minutes from EMU—don't miss one of summer's biggest events!

title: Ypsi Pride
venue: Depot Town, East Cross Street, Ypsilanti,
description:
Join the LGBT Resource Center and Enrollment Management at their vendor booths at Ypsi Pride on Saturday, July 18th.
12pm - 2pm: Dedicated Family Pride Time (younger children's activities, etc.) 2pm-10pm: General Pride Event. Location: Depot Town FREE!

title: Volunteering with the Farms at Trinity Health
venue: The Farms at Trinity Health - Ann Arbor, 5557 McAuley Dr., Ypsilanti
description: Join Honors College staff at the Farms at Trinity Health for a few hours of community service! Students can gain 3 hours of community service for each day they participate. Tasks will include farming work, such as harvesting, weeding, mulching, and more.

description: Your MBA, Your Way - One of the Top MBA Programs in Michigan. Learn skills you need to enhance your career. AACSB accredited. Provides freedom & flexibility to balance courses with everyday life. 1hr virtual information session on the COB's MBA program.
